notes.title: Pre-Alpha
notes.notes:
[h2]Development[/h2]
Skyfall has now reached the '[i]pre-alpha[/i]' development stage! The game's back-end coding is ~30% completed!

[i]Amazing progress for almost a year of development, yes I know.[/i]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 1 State Machine -> 2-3 State Machines per NPC
[*] Inventory system overhaul
[*] Combay System overhaul
[/list]

[h2]Skyfall's Future[/h2]

After concluding a poll with- [i]surprising[/i] results, the players have made it clear that Skyfall is to become a 2D/3D hybrid. Making a 2D/3D hybrid from scratch, will definitely be an interesting experience! In terms of actual development, current systems shouldn't need to be overhauled or re-coded; they just need to be modified to work with a 3D environment.
